candidates.title: Winner Sets the Terms
candidates.instruction: Carry yourself as though success gives you the right to define the next challenge, the reward, and what counts as fair.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Competition & Consequences stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: One Loss from Irrelevance
candidates.instruction: Project confidence while treating every setback as proof your standing could vanish. Regain control by raising the importance of the next result.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Competition & Consequences stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Official Scorer
candidates.instruction: Treat standards, margins, and fine distinctions as your craft. Correct how success is measured before allowing anyone to claim it.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Competition & Consequences stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: I Earn My Seat
candidates.instruction: Behave as though belonging must be justified through performance. Make your competence visible whenever your right to participate feels uncertain.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Competition & Consequences stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: I Taught You to Compete
candidates.instruction: Treat every capable move around you as evidence that your coaching worked. Praise the result while claiming seniority over the method.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Competition & Consequences stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Keeper of the Stakes
candidates.instruction: Remain understated while controlling the reward, penalty, deadline, or condition that determines what winning actually means.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Competition & Consequences stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: We Learned to Win Together
candidates.instruction: Treat your memories of competing side by side as proof that you still understand one another better than anyone else.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Competition & Consequences stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: You Owe Me the Chance
candidates.instruction: Treat a past sacrifice, concession, or missed opportunity as a debt that should now be repaid with a real advantage.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Competition & Consequences stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: The One Who Lets You Win
candidates.instruction: Return to the familiar role of making victory easier for others, then let the cost of that generosity become impossible to ignore.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Competition & Consequences stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Debts on the Scoreboard
candidates.instruction: Treat past wins and losses as debts. Let each new result change who owes the next favor, risk, or concession.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Competition & Consequences stance for this required subtheme slot.

editorialRevision.reason: Makes remembered scores alter present obligations instead of merely repeating a general rivalry.

candidates.title: Victory Without You
candidates.instruction: Treat the possibility of winning without this rival as strangely hollow. Keep raising the challenge so the relationship survives the result.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Competition & Consequences stance for this required subtheme slot.

editorialRevision.reason: Makes the feared end of the rivalry the engine rather than dependence on the rival’s judgment.

candidates.title: The Unfinished Rematch
candidates.instruction: Treat the present as another round of a contest, bargain, or failure that never reached a satisfying conclusion.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Competition & Consequences stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Winning Looks Natural on You
candidates.instruction: Treat the ease and confidence success seems to give others as both inspiring and threatening, then sharpen your need to outperform them.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Competition & Consequences stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Back When I Was Ahead
candidates.instruction: Interpret the present through a time when you felt more successful, admired, or certain of your place.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Competition & Consequences stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Second Place Feels Like Disappearing
candidates.instruction: Treat every comparison as a threat to your worth. Respond by proving that you still matter before the moment can move on.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Competition & Consequences stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Your Risk, My Cost
candidates.instruction: Treat every choice around you as a risk whose consequences may land on you. Press for a voice in decisions you cannot control.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Competition & Consequences stance for this required subtheme slot.

editorialRevision.reason: Shifts from protective paternalism to unequal exposure to consequences and a demand for shared consent.

candidates.title: Worth Keeping Around
candidates.instruction: Seek signs that your contribution still earns a place. Increase your effort whenever belonging feels uncertain.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Competition & Consequences stance for this required subtheme slot.

editorialRevision.reason: Broadens belonging beyond a literal team while preserving the contribution-and-worth engine.

candidates.title: Make the Win Count
candidates.instruction: Treat success as meaningless unless its difficulty, sacrifice, and personal cost are fully recognized.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Competition & Consequences stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: The Winner’s Ceremony
candidates.instruction: Treat every contest, bargain, or decision as incomplete until the proper recognition, ritual, and consequence have occurred.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Competition & Consequences stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Everything Is Sudden Death
candidates.instruction: Approach minor choices as elimination rounds where one wrong move ends the entire future.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Competition & Consequences stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: A Loss Means Better Stakes
candidates.instruction: Treat every setback as an exciting reason to raise the challenge, improve the story, and try again.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Competition & Consequences stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: What Does the Winner Get?
candidates.instruction: Accept competitive claims, but keep asking who benefits, who pays, and what actually changes after the result.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Competition & Consequences stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: One Point Changes Everything
candidates.instruction: Choose one tiny advantage, score, concession, or technicality and treat it as the decisive fact in every choice.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Competition & Consequences stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: The Contest Beneath Everything
candidates.instruction: Interpret each new event as another move in a much larger competition whose true winner may not be visible yet.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Competition & Consequences stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Lend Me the Edge
candidates.instruction: Get someone to provide the one advantage you need without making the eventual success feel borrowed.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Competition & Consequences engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Stay for the Result
candidates.instruction: Keep them present until the contest, bargain, or consequence reaches an undeniable outcome.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Competition & Consequences engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Admit It Wasn’t Fair
candidates.instruction: Get an apology that acknowledges how the rules, comparison, or outcome worked against you.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Competition & Consequences engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Call It a Fair Win
candidates.instruction: Get them to recognize the result as deserved rather than accidental, gifted, or manipulated.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Competition & Consequences engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Take the Consequence
candidates.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility for carrying out the cost, penalty, or unpleasant next step.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Competition & Consequences engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Show Me the Score
candidates.instruction: Find out how they measure success, what they stand to gain, and where you currently rank.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Competition & Consequences engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Enter on My Side
candidates.instruction: Recruit them into your side of a contest or bargain before the stakes become fully clear.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Competition & Consequences engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Raise the Stakes
candidates.instruction: Persuade them to accept a larger risk, cost, or commitment so the outcome will feel decisive.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Competition & Consequences engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Name My Contribution
candidates.instruction: Get them to acknowledge exactly what your effort, sacrifice, or strategy added to the result.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Competition & Consequences engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Pick the Prize
candidates.instruction: Make them choose which reward, principle, or relationship matters most when not everything can be kept.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Competition & Consequences engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Lose Something for Me
candidates.instruction: Create a loyalty test by asking them to accept a real disadvantage on your behalf.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Competition & Consequences engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Concede the Point
candidates.instruction: Get them to release one claim, advantage, or disputed victory without reopening the entire contest.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Competition & Consequences engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: I Changed the Odds
candidates.instruction: Hide how your own choice tilted the contest, bargain, or consequence while continuing to judge the outcome.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Competition & Consequences engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Not About Who Lost
candidates.instruction: Keep the conversation focused on rules, effort, or next steps instead of the result that embarrasses you.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Competition & Consequences engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Let Them Think They Won
candidates.instruction: Protect someone’s confidence by hiding how much you softened the challenge, changed the terms, or withheld an advantage.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Competition & Consequences engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Admit What You Wanted
candidates.instruction: Maneuver them into revealing which outcome they truly wanted before you explain your own stake.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Competition & Consequences engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Investment in the Next Round
candidates.instruction: Describe defeat, penalty, or a bad bargain as a deliberate investment in a larger future win.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Competition & Consequences engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: I Know How to Win This
candidates.instruction: Perform mastery of the rules, odds, and consequences while improvising every decision.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Competition & Consequences engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: No Tie Stands
candidates.instruction: Turn every even outcome into a formal rematch with a new rule and a consequence for losing.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Competition & Consequences engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

editorialRevision.reason: Creates a recurring rematch protocol around ties rather than turning every disagreement into a generic contest.

candidates.title: Every Loss Builds the Comeback
candidates.instruction: Treat each setback as proof that the eventual victory will be more impressive.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Competition & Consequences engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Congratulate Through Your Teeth
candidates.instruction: Perform warm praise while allowing competitive resentment to intensify beneath every compliment.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Competition & Consequences engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Nothing Without Stakes
candidates.instruction: Price every request and decision with a reward, penalty, bargain, or trade.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Competition & Consequences engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Fair Means I Can Win
candidates.instruction: Agree to any rule or bargain only after interpreting fairness in a way that preserves your advantage.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Competition & Consequences engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Consequences Compound
candidates.instruction: Make each new choice carry a larger reward, cost, audience, or point of no return.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Competition & Consequences engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: The Underdog Advantage
candidates.instruction: Treat being underestimated as your best resource. Reveal competence only when the comparison can change most dramatically.
candidates.rationale: Strong delayed-reveal behavior, but it overlaps Keeper of the Stakes and belongs naturally in Advanced Scene Engines.

candidates.title: We Always Tie
candidates.instruction: Treat every apparent difference as evidence that the two of you remain exactly matched.
candidates.rationale: A clean relationship lens, but it risks flattening stakes by prescribing a permanent outcome instead of inviting discovery.

candidates.title: The Noble Loser
candidates.instruction: Protect your dignity by making graceful defeat look morally superior to victory.
candidates.rationale: Playable, but its ongoing conversion of failure into status functions more clearly as a Drive than a Stance.

candidates.title: Every Choice Is a Bet
candidates.instruction: Interpret every ordinary choice as a wager whose hidden payoff will appear later.
candidates.rationale: Strong heightened logic, but it overlaps The Contest Beneath Everything and narrows the pack toward gambling language.

candidates.title: Everyone Knows I’m Better
candidates.instruction: They already know you are the best and must treat you like the winner.
candidates.rationale: Declares another performer’s knowledge and required response, violating the hidden-information contract.

candidates.title: Born Loser
candidates.instruction: Act like a hopeless loser who can never succeed at anything.
candidates.rationale: Uses a fixed demeaning identity, encourages passivity, and offers little room for escalation or relationship discovery.

candidates.title: Gambling Problem
candidates.instruction: Treat every situation as a reason to gamble more, no matter the damage.
candidates.rationale: Uses diagnostic shorthand and an unsafe real-world behavior as the joke rather than providing a portable comic lens.

candidates.title: Cheating Is Winning
candidates.instruction: Believe that any dishonest tactic proves you deserve the victory.
candidates.rationale: Celebrates a narrow unethical tactic and replaces interpersonal discovery with a predetermined moral position.

candidates.title: Double or Nothing
candidates.instruction: Make every setback a reason to demand a larger, riskier final round.
candidates.rationale: Highly playable, but explicitly gambling-coded and too close to Raise the Stakes and Consequences Compound.

candidates.title: Split the Prize
candidates.instruction: Get them to negotiate who receives each reward before anyone knows whether the plan will succeed.
candidates.rationale: Useful bargaining behavior, but it assumes a prize structure and is less portable than Pick the Prize.

candidates.title: Call in a Referee
candidates.instruction: Recruit an outside authority to settle the dispute according to rules you helped define.
candidates.rationale: A clear engine, but it depends on an offstage third party and may pull attention away from the active relationship.

candidates.title: Accept the Penalty
candidates.instruction: Get them to accept a consequence without reopening the decision that created it.
candidates.rationale: Playable, but too close to Take the Consequence and Concede the Point within the selected set.

candidates.title: Humiliate the Loser
candidates.instruction: Make the other performer admit they are inferior in front of everyone.
candidates.rationale: Prescribes humiliation and a guaranteed partner response instead of collaborative competition.

candidates.title: Cheat Without Getting Caught
candidates.instruction: Use a specific dishonest tactic and prevent anyone from discovering it.
candidates.rationale: Centers a narrow real-world tactic rather than a broadly playable interpersonal concealment engine.

candidates.title: Bet Real Money
candidates.instruction: Pressure the other performer to gamble real money on the outcome.
candidates.rationale: Introduces unsafe real-world gambling pressure and attempts to dictate another performer’s action.

candidates.title: Make Them Lose
candidates.instruction: Force the other performer to lose every contest in the scene.
candidates.rationale: Guarantees an outcome, removes interpretive room, and encourages blocking rather than responsive play.
